instruction.name: vhaddw.w.h
instruction.description: Add odd-positioned signed 16-bit elements in `a` to even-positioned signed 16-bit elements in `b`, sign-extending both to 32-bit, to get the 32-bit result.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX widening/narrowing integer instruction. Measured on LA664 with positive integer operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
